# Enum option values that name `Object.prototype` members (`toString`,
# `constructor`, `__proto__`, ...): TS `getEnumValue` checks `name in
# values`, so they pass, and the renderer gets the inherited function (or
# `Object.prototype` for `__proto__`). In C#, boolean-valued options take it
# as truthy, `features` has none of its fields, `csharp-version` compares
# as NaN, and `framework`, `any-type` and `base-class` fail where the value
# is switched on or emitted.
